Audio Remaster Notes:

Adobe Audition 2018 CC
FLAC files are converted to 48000 hz 32 bit WAV for processing
Volume reduced to about -6Db
Processed 1266 possibly clipped samples with Scientific Filter Preset I created
The left and right channels were volume matched
The audio file then was volume matched to -20.95 LUFS

HarBal 3.7
Performed an eq match to my Roger Waters-Pink Floyd samples as a starting point, tweaked,
and outputted the processed audio files

Dogs Repair HarBal 3.7 and Audition 2018 CC
Used the Eq matched Dogs from the original recording as a reference
Auto Center Panning processed the Dogs audience recording
Volume matched the Dogs audience recording to the eq matched Dogs from the original
Eq matched the Dogs audience recording using the eq matched Dogs from the original as the reference
Volume matched the eq matched Dogs audience recording to the eq matched Dogs from the original again
Determined the length and placement of the repair cut in for both Dogs recordings and created markers
Volume matched the repaired portion from both the audience recording and the original
Deleted the audio portion from the original and copied the audio portion from the audience recording

Adobe Audition 2018 CC
Eq matched audio files are loaded into Audition
Auto Center Panning processed
Adjusted audio peaks that were over approx -6 Db
Normalized Audio to 0 db

Ozone 8
Ran the Master Assistant scan process several times till I determined the right combination of settings.
Fine tuned the parameters for Eq, Dynamic EQ, and volume Maximixer. Dynamics processing was not necessary.
Maximized volume to approximately -17.1 LUFS with max peak level of .1 dbTP using tru peak limiting
Converted audio to 44.1khz 16 bit file
Dithered with Izotope MBIT - Medium amount and Higher Noise Shaping

Traders Little Helper
WAV files encoded to flac 8, aligned sector boundaries, and tested
Created Checksum and torrent file

The repair of the clipped samples and Dogs and remaster was approved to share.

Enjoy
